content: Timing guarantees Type: valid Description: The BSWMD template SHALL allow specifying the guaranteed or estimated reaction time of the BSW module functions (main functions and API calls incl. callbacks & ISR). Rationale: To be able to do timing analysis of Application SW-Components, the BSW needs to define timing guarantees. Dependencies:  Use Case: With the knowledge of the guaranteed execution time the design of exclusive area access can be optimized, depending on the duration an interrupt block might be possible. Supporting Material: [RS_SWCT_02050] Requirements on Software Component Template [14]
